method: Read-only source review plus one Node-native TypeScript fixture construction. No browser, original application, importer rerun, full test suite, package, artifact or product mutation.

resolvedFindings.description: Clearing text alone left six nonempty richText projections; parent now uses replaceWidgetText imported from rich-text.ts. Current fixture strictly parses.

Renaming six Chip widget IDs retained self-action targets using old imported IDs; parent now explicitly makes all gallery entries static with interactions:[], while original imported-widget JSON remains unchanged.

The exterior pixel is now (2,2), outside the radius-18 painted corner rather than on the stroke/antialias boundary at (5,5). The node Undo case reselects the widget after App clears selection. Both retain the geometry, color, full-document and history assertions.

checks.desktopNativeImport: Actual original .rplib import then native Electron Save to .rea.json; deep equality of all 18 saved full widgets by original ID against complete-document import records; source hash checked before and after.
checks.runtimeScenario: Preview and exported offline HTML share radius, size, mask, hover/selected composition and two local pixel assertions on one genuine imported slider; 18 gallery paths each assert four cubic segments.
checks.authoring: Width/height/radius/mask edits deep-compare whole document; four undo/redo commands; numeric cubic handle edit exits family, save retains exact modified path, undo restores. Reopen is exercised through UI.
checks.artifactVerification: Verifier requires no skipped/flaky/unexpected results, source/build/package hashes, saved/exported/screenshot byte hashes, five exact-package scripts, historical artifact restoration and explicit original-GUI/pixel/DLL false flags.

validationLimits: This review validates workflow construction and assertions, not completion of the parent browser/package runs. Final verifier counts remain acceptance requirements until those runs finish.
The desktop original-file action imports .rplib and saves .rea.json. It does not write original .rp/.rplib format; mocked native picker selection is not native-dialog GUI automation.
The gallery is an authored layout and paint demonstration with original path/dimensions/radius/mask. It is not an original Axure canvas screenshot or unchanged original page.
All 28 raw paths are covered by inventory/renderer tests; only 18 fully imported widgets are exercised in this workflow. Eight fit-parent and two repeater-template exclusions remain explicit.
Gallery curve-count checks do not establish complete original initial-paint pixel equality. Independent raw path/import tests and source comparisons provide geometry provenance.
The node-edit test uses numeric Control 1 X %, not pointer dragging; parameterized rendering versus stored editing anchors remains an explicitly retained product limitation.

Reopen currently starts from the same expected document state. The picker/open call is exercised, but equality alone is not a negative control proving the old state was replaced; existing distinct-state initial open/import checks remain independent.
pendingAcceptanceWiring: The reviewed verifier still names native-pills-focused-e2e.json and focused-artifacts. Parent stated it will bind the successful validated report/restoration record after the in-progress run. Review does not certify the earlier failed focused report.
